title: Unjiniyela Osebenza Ezindaweni Zamakhasimende
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Umsebenzi

Unjiniyela Osebenza Ezindaweni Zamakhasimende umi emngceleni ophakathi kwenkundla eyinhloko ye-Kyber nezindawo zokusebenza lapho amakhasimende ethu eyisebenzisa khona.

Usebenzisana eduze namathimba amakhasimende ukuthuthukisa, ukulungiselela kanye nokufaka i-Kyber ezimweni zangempela: uguqula i-SDK yethu ibe yisixazululo esihambisana nemishini, nenethiwekhi kanye nemikhawulo yokubambezeleka yekhasimende ngalinye.

Lo msebenzi awukona nje owokuthuthukisa kuphela, futhi awukona owokusekela kuphela. Uphethe wonke umjikelezo ohlangothini lwekhasimende: ukucacisa izidingo, ukuklama indlela yokuhlanganisa, ukubhala ikhodi, ukuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe bekhasimende, kanye nokwenza ukuthi uhlelo lusebenze ngokugcwele.

Uma kukhona okonakalayo endaweni yokusebenza lapho kusele isikhala esingu-2 ms kuphela, nguwe oqonda ngokwanele kokubili ukusebenza kwangaphakathi kwenkundla yethu kanye nesimo sekhasimende ukuze ukulungise.

Uzosebenza ngaphakathi kwamathimba amakhasimende ukuze kutholakale ngokushesha izixazululo ezenzelwe wona ngqo ezinhlelweni eziyinkimbinkimbi neziguquka njalo.

Imisebenzi Eyinhloko:

  • Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwamathimba amakhasimende ukuze uqonde imishini yawo, amanethiwekhi awo kanye nemikhawulo yawo yokusebenza, bese uyiguqula ibe yizidingo zobuchwepheshe ezicacile
  • Ukuklama, ukwakha nokufaka izixazululo zokuhlanganisa ezenzelwe ikhasimende ngalinye phezu kwe-Kyber SDK nesendlalelo sokuthutha idatha
  • Ukulungisa kahle uchungechunge lonke lokucubungula kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni ukuze kufinyelelwe imigomo eqinile yesikhathi sangempela (imikhawulo yokubambezeleka, imikhawulo yezithombe, ukungazinzi kwesikhathi sokufika kwedatha, ukulahleka kwamaphakethe ku-QUIC)
  • Ukuhlanganisa i-Kyber nemishini nezinhlelo zekhompyutha zekhasimende — izinto ezinyakazisayo, izinzwa, ukusakazwa kwevidiyo kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula
  • Ukuhlonza nokuxazulula izinkinga ezinhlelweni ezisebenza bukhoma, kaningi ngaphansi kwemikhawulo eqinile yokubambezeleka nokwethembeka
  • Ukubuyisela izidingo zamakhasimende nalokho okufundwe endaweni yokusebenza emkhiqizweni oyinhloko; ukubambisana namathimba enkundla nawe-elekthronikhi ekwakhiweni kwesakhiwo sohlelo
  • Ukulungiselela imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, imihlahlandlela yokuhlanganisa kanye nezibonelo zokufaka uhlelo
  • Ukwenza ukubuyekezwa kwekhodi ezingeni eliphezulu nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yobunjiniyela kuyo yonke imisebenzi ebhekene namakhasimende

Amakhono Adingekayo

  • Ulwazi olujulile lwesakhiwo sangaphakathi se-Windows nezinhlelo ezihambisana nayo
  • Ukuqonda okuqinile kwezindlela zokuvumelanisa, ukuphathwa kwememori, nokuphathwa kwamaphutha ezingeni lesistimu, kanye nokuqonda okucacile komngcele ophakathi kwesimo somsebenzisi nesimo somongo wesistimu yokusebenza, kanjalo nokuphathwa kwezikhathi zokungena zabasebenzisi
  • Ulwazi olungokoqobo lwamathuluzi e-Windows okuthola amaphutha nokuhlaziya
  • Izilimi Zokuhlela: C / C++ / Rust / x86/x64
  • Amathuluzi Nesimo Sokusebenza: Visual Studio namathuluzi okwakha e-Windows, GitLab kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ngokubambisana

Wena

  • Iminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengu-10 yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha, unomlando oqinile wokwethula izinhlelo ezisebenza ngokugcwele
  • Ubuchule ku-Rust, ku-C noma olimini lomshini olusezingeni eliphansi — kanye nekhono lokufunda nokulungisa amaphutha kuzo zontathu
  • Ukuqonda okuqinile kwezinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela nezinokubambezeleka okuphansi (imikhawulo yokubambezeleka, imikhawulo yezithombe, ukuhlelwa kwemisebenzi, ukulawulwa kokuminyana kwedatha)
  • Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zamanethiwekhi nezokusakaza; ukujwayelana nezivumelwano zokuthutha idatha (QUIC, UDP, TCP) kanye nezinzuzo nobuthakathaka bazo
  • Ukukhululeka ukusebenza ngqo namakhasimende: ukuqoqa izidingo, ukucacisa ububanzi bomsebenzi, nokuchaza ngokucacile izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
  • Umoya wokuzibophezela — ukhululekile ukuthatha inkinga kusukela esidingweni esingacacile kuze kube wuhlelo olufakiwe nolusebenzayo
  • Ukuzimisela ukuvakashela izindawo zamakhasimende nokusebenza ezindaweni zokusebenza zangempela

Amakhono Angaba Yinzuzo:

  • Ulwazi kumarobhothi, kumadrone, ezimotweni ezizihambelayo noma ekulawuleni imishini ukude
  • Isisekelo kuchungechunge lokucubungula ividiyo nemidiya noma ekucubunguleni amasignali (ulwazi oluhlobene ne-VLC/FFmpeg luyinzuzo)
  • Ukujwayelana ne-SDR, nezinhlelo ezishumekiwe, noma ukuhlanganiswa kwemishini ezingeni le-PCB
  • Iminikelo kumaphrojekthi omthombo ovulekile
  • Ulwazi lwangaphambili njengonjiniyela osebenza ezindaweni zamakhasimende, unjiniyela wamakhasimende noma wasendaweni yokusebenza, noma njengomklami wezixazululo

Inqubo Yenhlolokhono

  1. Ucingo Lokuqala Lwemizuzu Engu-15: Ingxoxo emfushane mayelana nogqozi lwakho nokufaneleka kwakho, siphinde siphendule nemibuzo yakho engahlobene nobuchwepheshe.
  2. Izinhlolokhono Ezimbili Zobuchwepheshe Nezomkhiqizo, Ngayinye Ihora Elilodwa: Ukuhlola ngokujulile indlela yakho yokuxazulula izinkinga, nomphathi wethu wezobuchwepheshe (CTO) kanye/noma nomklami wethu oholayo wezixazululo
  3. Ukwazana Nethimba: Ingxoxo engahlelekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana kahle nesiko lethu lokusebenza.

Esikunikezayo

  • Amaphrojekthi anobuchwepheshe obujulile nayinselele engqondweni
  • Isimo sokusebenza esazisa ubuchule bangempela bobunjiniyela futhi esigxile kwezobuchwepheshe (ayikho imihlangano engenamsebenzi noma imibiko engadingekile)
  • Amaphrojekthi ayinselele engqondweni asemngceleni wokulawula imishini ukude ngesikhathi sangempela
  • Inkululeko enkulu ekuthatheni izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
